# SCC File Status.vi

![SCC File Status.vi function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/SCC-08.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Reads source control status for each selected file and its provider status flags.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

| Displayed terminal / internal ID | Accepted / resolved type | Studio connection | Unwired input default | Meaning |

| files `files` | `array<path,rank=1>` | Required | Not specified | Paths of files targeted by this source control operation. |
